title: dev's --tmp-dir option is ported onto refactor's build modules
body:
`origin/dev` is one commit past e8655c9, where `refactor` branched: db9b5a9, "Add an option to specify the directory for temporary scratch files", by Jeb Rosen with Opus 5.5. It adds `sufr create -T/--tmp-dir DIR` and `SuffixArrayBuilder::with_temp_dir`, writes the scratch files into a `sufr-*` subdirectory of that directory or of `std::env::temp_dir`, and has 44 lines of CLI tests and a CHANGELOG entry.

It lands on `libsufr/src/sufr_builder.rs`, which `refactor` dissolved into `libsufr/src/build.rs` and `build/{partition,scratch,sort,write}.rs`, so none of its hunks apply. On `refactor` the scratch choice is `ScratchKind::{Disk, Memory}` in `build/scratch.rs`, with `NamedTempFile` in the system temp dir.

## Proposal

Port rather than merge: a `temp_dir: Option<PathBuf>` on the builder with `with_temp_dir`, passed into `ScratchKind::Disk` and used by the `NamedTempFile` builder; the `-T` flag and its tests on the CLI; the CHANGELOG line. The CLI's frozen surface then matches dev's again.
